.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r1/rules/projects/webdev-task-template (tree listing of template files: tests/gates, tests/scored, scoring.toml, tools)
task/solution/app/public/js/{app.js,board.js} (grep: EventSource live channel, drag handlers), task/solution/app/public/styles.css (overflow rules)
evidence: STRENGTHS (most interactive/time-varying behaviour is genuinely exercised, not scored from a still first paint): functional/prompt.md:45 protocol V keeps Rafael's board open, has Mei act in an independent context, forbids reload/click and says 'wait up to 15 seconds (a wait-for call, or snapshots; accept what is present at the first snapshot at or after 15 seconds)', graded by hro_live_board (judge.toml:336-342). hro_msg_exchange (350) bounds the live reply at 15 s without reload. hro_refused_put_back (188) reads document.activeElement after a refused move; hro_msg_compose (359) drives Shift+Enter/Enter and reads focus; hro_drafts (422) switches views and reloads; hro_restart uses restart_app. polish/prompt.md:14 gives a general rule 'After that action do not reload, navigate, click or type in the observed page until the update has been seen or 15 seconds have passed' and reads activeElement/field values/scroll offsets with page.evaluate; hro_pol_live_board (43), hro_pol_live_thread (52), hro_pol_earlier_place (61, getBoundingClientRect before/after loading earlier), hro_pol_failed_send (70, aborted request / setOffline), hro_pol_session_resume (79, second-tab sign-out) all act and observe over time. Viewport/theme: instruction.md says 'We don't need theme switching or a special phone layout'; visual/prompt.md:14 assesses 'desktop craft at a conventional desktop viewport' with 'No phone layout or theme switching is required', so no resize/toggle is owed. Drag: hireops_rules.md:52 'Dragging may be offered as well' makes drag optional, and hro_move_one_stage (107) correctly grades non-drag moves only. DEFECT: hireops_rules.md:117-119 makes live arrival a public requirement for more than cards and messages: 'within 15 seconds, with no reload and nothing clicked: ... unread counts change, and new messages and seen marks arrive.' Functional protocol U (functional/prompt.md:39) and its criteria give no wait bound and no no-reload/no-navigation rule for those observations: 'with Rafael's page on the Board, Tomas sends two messages; read Rafael's count on that conversation and his total, then open it'; 'Tomas opens it: seen'; 'as Noor (independent context) send a message; read Rafael's place, the notice and the unread count'. hro_unread_counts (386: 'after Tomas's two new messages Rafael's count ... rises by exactly two'), hro_seen (404: 'after Tomas opens it, it shows as seen') and hro_unread_scrolled_up (395: 'he is told there is one new message') state no 15-second window and no 'without reload'. The functional prompt has no equivalent of polish's general wait rule (polish/prompt.md:14 applies only to polish rows). So for 5.5 weight-points of time-varying criteria (unread_counts 2, scrolled_up 2, seen 1.5) the judge is not told to wait for the update, nor forbidden to reload/navigate to obtain it. The live channels for unread counts and seen marks are not graded as live anywhere else (hro_pol_live_thread grades only the message appearing in the open thread). Runtime: no configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading ... absent'); the scripted golden driver (workspace.cjs:330, waitForFunction on '.receipt' === 'Seen', timeout 10000) shows the golden's SSE seen receipt updates live, which is golden behaviour evidence, not judge behaviour evidence. SECONDARY (P3): hro_pol_live_board (polish judge.toml:43) says 'scroll the page so it is not at the top' and then grades 'the scroll position has not been reset'; a conforming fixed-viewport layout with only inner scroll containers (rules leave layout to the implementer; REVIEW_POLICY lists scroll containers as a hidden-requirement risk) may have no page scroll, and the criterion gives no fallback (scroll the board/column container), so outcomes for that case are undefined.
counterexample: (1) Conforming app wrongly failed: a submission that polls every 12 s (rules §5 allow polling with a 15 s bound). In protocol U the judge has Tomas send two messages in the independent context, then immediately (2-4 s later) snapshots Rafael's page; the total and per-conversation counts have not yet changed and the scrolled-up notice has not appeared. Nothing in the functional prompt tells the judge to wait up to 15 s, so hro_unread_counts and hro_unread_scrolled_up (4 weight-points) can be scored 0 for a compliant app. (2) Non-compliant app wrongly passed: a submission whose unread counts and seen marks only refresh on reload or on navigating to the Conversations view (violating rules §5 'with no reload and nothing clicked: ... unread counts change ... seen marks arrive'). Reading 'Rafael's count on that conversation' from the Board naturally involves navigating to Conversations, and nothing forbids a reload before reading 'seen', so hro_unread_counts and hro_seen pass while the live-update requirement for counts and marks is never measured.
suggested_fix: In functional protocol U (and in hro_unread_counts, hro_seen and hro_unread_scrolled_up) add: 'Without reloading, navigating or clicking in Rafael's page, wait up to 15 seconds (accept the first snapshot at or after 15 s) and read his total unread count / the seen mark / the new-message notice; only then open the conversation', and make the criteria fail if the change appears only after reload or navigation; optionally add to hro_pol_live_board 'scroll the page, or the board's scroll container if the page itself does not scroll'.
